decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a reliable, high-performance portable speaker. My consideration set included a range of options from premium home audio (Sony SRS-RA3000) to ultra-portable mini speakers (EWA, JBL). The Sony was impressive but ultimately too stationary and expensive for my current outdoor-focused needs. While the JBL Go 3 is a brand I trust, some user reviews mentioned short battery life. The INSMY and EWA units offered great value, but I felt hesitant about the long-term durability of these budget-tier brands. The JBL Clip 3 was an attractive option, but its status as a 'renewed' product made me cautious about potential battery degradation. Additionally, a significant portion of the product feed consisted of accessories like carrying cases and silicone covers rather than actual speakers, which limited the selection of new mid-to-high range devices. Consequently, I decided to wait for a broader selection or a better sale.
